headline: Actor Zaher Alvi sent to jail after surrendering in wife's death case
summary: A Dhaka court denied bail to the actor in a case alleging abetment of suicide of his wife, social media influencer Afra Ivnath Khan Ikra.
details: A Dhaka court has sent actor Niamot Ullah Bhuiyan, popularly known as Zaher Alvi, to jail after denying his bail application following his surrender before the court.
The case involves the allegations of abetment of suicide of his wife, Afra Ivnath Khan Ikra, a social media influencer who was found dead in their Mirpur DOHS flat on February 28.
Ikra's father, Kabir Hayat Khan, filed the case with Pallabi Police Station on March 1, naming Alvi and his mother, Nasrin Sultana Shyuli, as the accused.
The case statement alleges that family disputes and various forms of abuse had driven the influencer to take her own life.
Ikra was rushed to Kurmitola General Hospital after being found hanging in the flat, where she was declared dead.
Alvi's mother, Nasrin Sultana, had previously surrendered and secured bail on June 4.
Alvi was abroad during the time of his wife's death and later sought protection from the High Court to return to Bangladesh.
Following the High Court's ruling in his favor, Alvi returned to the home on June 5 and has now surrendered to the court.
caption:
Actor Zaher Alvi is behind bars after surrendering in a case over his wife's death.

A Dhaka court has sent actor Niamot Ullah Bhuiyan, popularly known as Zaher Alvi, to jail after denying his bail application following his surrender before the court.

The case involves the allegations of abetment of suicide of his wife, Afra Ivnath Khan Ikra, a social media influencer who was found dead in their Mirpur DOHS flat on February 28.

Ikra's father, Kabir Hayat Khan, filed the case with Pallabi Police Station on March 1, naming Alvi and his mother, Nasrin Sultana Shyuli, as the accused.

The case statement alleges that family disputes and various forms of abuse had driven the influencer to take her own life.

Ikra was rushed to Kurmitola General Hospital after being found hanging in the flat, where she was declared dead.

Alvi's mother, Nasrin Sultana, had previously surrendered and secured bail on June 4.

Alvi was abroad during the time of his wife's death and later sought protection from the High Court to return to Bangladesh.

Following the High Court's ruling in his favor, Alvi returned to the home on June 5 and has now surrendered to the court.

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star, Somoy News

headline: 666 children die as measles outbreak kills hundreds in Bangladesh
summary: Five more children died within 24 hours as the death toll from measles symptoms rises to 666 over the last three months.
details: A severe measles outbreak has claimed the lives of 666 children in Bangladesh over the past three months, with five more deaths reported in the last 24 hours.
Reports indicate that over 100,000 children have been affected by the virus across the country.
In Sylhet, two more children with measles symptoms have recently died, contributing to the rising national toll.
Health authorities are monitoring the situation as the number of cases continues to climb rapidly.
caption:
666 children dead in 3 months. Over 100,000 infected. A measles outbreak is ravaging Bangladesh.

A severe measles outbreak has claimed the lives of 666 children in Bangladesh over the past three months, with five more deaths reported in the last 24 hours.

Reports indicate that over 100,000 children have been affected by the virus across the country.

In Sylhet, two more children with measles symptoms have recently died, contributing to the rising national toll.

Health authorities are monitoring the situation as the number of cases continues to climb rapidly.
